sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite suffering a recent loss, Sandbach remain unbeaten over their previous four matches before that (WIN-DRAW-WIN-WIN), demonstrating solid form overall. They face an Alsager side struggling near the foot of the table with just 4 points, having won only once in their last eight matches.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to bounce back from a recent loss and close the 2-point gap on leaders Sandbach. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth travel to Eccleshall in a mid-table clash between sides with contrasting recent form—Bridgnorth have won their last three matches after two earlier defeats, while Eccleshall have won their last three games. Wolverhampton Casuals (4th, 19 points) host Wednesfield Community (9th, 13 points) on Saturday before travelling to Brereton Social on Wednesday evening, giving Casuals a demanding midweek fixture. Bilston Town, currently 6th with 17 points and three straight wins, entertain Foley Meir at home on Saturday. The relegation battle involves several struggling sides: Widnes Town (bottom, 2 points) travel to Brereton Social, Telford Town (18th, 6 points) visit Cheadle Heath Nomads (17th, 7 points), and Crewe (16th, 9 points) host Allscott Heath (11th, 11 points). Barnton (7th, 15 points) play Shawbury United (15th, 10 points) in a contest between mid-table and lower-table sides, while Market Drayton Town (10th, 12 points) entertain New Mills (8th, 14 points) on Saturday.
